title: Quick Start and Controlled Stop
description: Players explode from a dead stop for a short burst, then brake to a fully controlled stop, pairing the two skills that bookend almost every chair movement in a game.

content.objective: Explode from a stop and then brake to a fully controlled stop without rocking or tipping.
content.setup: Players line up under the basket with open space ahead.
instructions: From a complete stop, push explosively for three strokes.
Brake smoothly to a controlled stop using both push rims evenly.
Hold the stopped position steady for two seconds before starting again.
Repeat for eight to ten reps, resting briefly between each.
coachingPoints: Drive hard off the very first stroke rather than easing in.
Brake with both hands evenly to avoid spinning off-line.
Stay upright through the brake — don't let the trunk pitch forward.
commonMistakes: Braking with only one hand, which spins the chair off-line.
Rocking back and forth after the stop instead of holding it steady.
Gripping the push rim too tightly, which slows the stroke down.
content.safety: Leave enough clear space ahead for a genuine quick-start burst.
